title: BindingAcceptanceReceipt — an application records its own decision
description: OPTIONAL. Records that a particular application accepted a particular bindingHash under a particular policy version. It is an APPLICATION DECISION and is not the source of the identity proof: delete every receipt and the observations still prove exactly what they proved before.

policyHash.$comment: artifactId of the ApplicationAcceptancePolicy this decision was made under. It is a REFERENCE, and it is covered by this receipt's signature — changing it invalidates both the signature and the receipt's own artifactId.

observationRefs.$comment: artifactIds of the exact observations this decision rested on, so a reader who disagrees can reproduce it

notice.const: This is an application decision under its own published policy. It is not the source of the identity proof and confers no protocol standing.
notice.$comment: A const string, so the disclaimer cannot be dropped while the artifact still validates.
